Manage the storage network, including Fibre Channel zoning, iSCSI or NVMe-oF configuration, multipathing, and the VLAN and MTU work that storage connectivity depends on. Own array lifecycle including firmware and OS upgrades, controller and drive replacements, and Dell support cases through to closure. Plan and execute storage migrations and array-based replication with minimal disruption to workloads. Serve as technical lead during storage-impacting incidents, coordinating with clients, internal teams, and vendor support. Review capacity, performance, and health reporting and act on risks before they affect clients. Automate recurring work such as provisioning, reporting, and health checks using scripting and array APIs. Mentor junior engineers and work with virtualization, data protection, and network teams so storage fits the wider environment rather than sitting beside it. MUST BE fluent in English Hands-on ownership of at least one Dell platform at depth: PowerFlex, PowerStore, PowerScale, or PowerVault, including provisioning, upgrades, performance tuning, and support case management. Working knowledge of block, file, and object storage and of how storage behaves beneath VMware vSphere and Windows or Linux hosts. Hands-on experience with storage networking across Fibre Channel and IP-based protocols (iSCSI, NFS, SMB, NVMe over TCP), including multipathing. Experience planning and executing storage migrations and configuring array-based replication. Automation ability using AI tooling, scripting (PowerShell, Python, or an equivalent), and direct work against array APIs. Experience writing formal root cause analyses and working inside a structured change management process. Clear client-facing communication and the ability to work independently across many client environments at once without losing track of any of them. Prior MSP or other multi-client experience, ideally supporting several customer environments at once. Associate's or bachelor's degree in information technology or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience. Preferred Qualifications: Dell Technologies certifications on PowerFlex, PowerStore, PowerScale, or PowerVault, or a comparable enterprise storage certification. Experience with Dell data protection platforms such as PowerProtect Data Domain or with Veeam, and with Dell VxRail. Experience with another enterprise array vendor and with environments governed by compliance standards such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, or TPN.
